Changelog

Upcoming deprecations can be found on the deprecations page.

October, 2026

Oct 8
Feature
gpt-6.1-sol
v1/responses

Added Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol in the Responses API. Use gpt-6.1-sol with service_tier: "ultrafast" to reduce the time between generated output tokens. It is available to all API users, subject to rate limits, with global processing and US and EU data residency. See Ultrafast pricing.

Oct 7
Update
chat-latest

Updated the chat-latest snapshot, which points to the latest model available in ChatGPT for Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users. We recommend leveraging the GPT-6 model family for production API usage, but feel free to use this model to test the latest improvements for chat use cases. The underlying model snapshot will be regularly updated. Read more here.

Oct 6
Feature
gpt-6-luna
v1/decisions

Released the Decisions API in beta with gpt-6-luna. Turn text and images into typed answers 10x faster than the Responses API.

Oct 6
Update

Simplified API usage tiers from five to three: Build, Launch, and Grow. Organizations automatically upgrade as total credit purchases reach tier minimums. See usage tiers for monthly usage limits and how to view rate limits for each model.

Oct 5
Feature

Added an in-product flow for HIPAA compliance support in API Organization settings > General. Admins of eligible organizations can now accept the standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and enable HIPAA compliance support for their organization. See the Help Center for eligibility, covered services, and configuration requirements.

September, 2026

Sep 29
Feature

Added computer use to the Agents API. Agents can complete tasks in an OpenAI-hosted browser, with website access approvals and sign-in handled by your application.
